decisions: The endings use one style throughout: a past-tense resume with no subject ('Retired and...', 'After retiring, ...', 'Went into politics and...', 'Promoted to EFF ...'). The pilot is the player's own original character, and leaving out the subject also avoids choosing a pronoun. This is deliberate narration style, not a dropped subject in dialogue.
Earth Federation Forces is shortened to EFF (the glossary's short form) and ranks to Lt. General / Maj. General so the promotion lines fit their slots.
The \n line count of every row matches the JP; the indentation spaces are dropped.
History rows: unit names use official EN spellings and battle names follow 'Defense of X'.
uncertain: S02821: 'Babylonia Banguard' (F91 Crossbone Vanguard flagship) is not in the glossary; spelling is from memory and needs checking.
S02822: the date prefix '0133.06' plus two spaces is kept as in the JP; unclear whether the game lays it out in a date column.
S02867: 'Arms King' is 9 bytes in a 7-byte slot; fallback is 'Tycoon'.
